samplingTemperature: omitted all; provider defaults cannot be made equal because Luna does not support temperature
provider: pin order+only exact endpoint tag; allow_fallbacks false; identity mismatch rejected; winners apply to deployment configuration incl quantization
longHistory: same fixed user sequence; own prior responses retained; divergence is an outcome, not identical-history claim. Semantic path isolated quota tests needed.
latency: total user-turn latency includes all subcalls; common generous harness limit, NOT production latency proof
ranking: critical failure minimum, zero for release
smallSample: No statistical equivalence or population conversion claim; known vs fresh distinct; all-started denominator and censored counts; report intervals when useful
judge: independent Codex model not evaluated provider; deterministic identity/card/price/history signals + manual blind response review; no self-only evaluation
stopping: provider failure stops batch, no retry of dispatched failed case; missing stays missing; hard budget reserves all UTF8 request bytes/schema plus total max output including reasoning
integration: winner configs only into separate candidate; two brand-new sealed fresh sets >=90% each and critical0 plus long/browser/history/latency; no automatic deploy
